tagline: A global applied solutions provider serving niche markets with mission-critical components for everyday life.
hero_kpi_rationale: The Health Science Technologies (HST) segment is IDEX's primary driver of organic growth, fueled by strong demand in data centers, semiconductors, and pharmaceutical markets, representing 43% of sales in 2025.

kpis.name: Health Science Technologies Segment Growth
kpis.explanation: Portion of sales from the Health Science Technologies segment, which includes analytical instruments and medical markets.
kpis.description: The HST segment increased its contribution to total sales, rising from 39% in 2024 to 43% in 2025, driven by demand in semiconductors, data centers, and pharmaceuticals.
kpis.signal: HST becomes the largest segment with 43% of sales in 2025.

kpis.name: Organic Sales Growth
kpis.explanation: Sales growth excluding foreign exchange, acquisitions, and divestitures.
kpis.description: Organic growth of 1% in 2025 was driven by price increases across all segments, partially offsetting volume declines in FMT and FSDP.
kpis.signal: Positive organic growth despite volume declines in two segments.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Consolidated gross margin after cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: Gross margin improved from 44.2% in 2024 to 44.5% in 2025, supported by productivity gains and price increases.
kpis.signal: Margin improvement due to operational productivity.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Operating margin declined from 20.7% in 2024 (677.2/3268.8) to 20.2% in 2025 (699.3/3457.5), with operating income growing 3% versus 6% in sales growth.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in operating margin despite sales growth, impacted by restructuring expenses and higher interest costs.

kpis.name: Free Cash Flow
kpis.description: FCF reached $616.8 million in 2025, up 2%, representing 103% of adjusted net income.
kpis.signal: Strong FCF at 103% of adjusted net income.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.description: Calculated as the difference between operating cash flow ($680.4M) and free cash flow ($616.8M), resulting in $63.6M of Capex in 2025.

kpis.name: HST Sales Mix
kpis.explanation: Proportion of total sales from the Health Science Technologies segment.
kpis.description: HST sales mix increased from 39% in 2024 to 43% in 2025, driven by semiconductor, data center, and pharmaceutical markets.
kpis.signal: HST becomes the primary growth engine, now the leading segment in sales contribution.

kpis.name: FMT Sales Mix
kpis.explanation: Proportion of total sales from the Fluid Metering Technologies segment.
kpis.description: FMT sales mix declined from 38% in 2024 to 35% in 2025, due to weaker demand in chemical, energy, and agricultural applications.
kpis.signal: Downtrend in industrial and agricultural markets.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.explanation: Total assets on the balance sheet extracted from yfinance.
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance balance sheet over the last fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of 6.93 Mds € last year

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.explanation: Total debt on the balance sheet extracted from yfinance.
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance balance sheet over the last fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 1.85 Mds € last year

kpis.name: Total Revenue

risks.title: Inability to Continue to Develop New Products
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on its ability to continue developing innovative new products. Failure to deliver new, innovative, and competitive products could limit sales growth and negatively affect financial condition and cash flows. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Growth Strategy Includes Acquisitions and Integration Risks
risks.score_rationale: IDEX's historical growth has included acquisitions and divestitures. The company may be unable to identify suitable targets, negotiate favorable terms, secure necessary financing, or successfully integrate acquisitions. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Dependence on Raw Materials and Supply Chain
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on the availability of critical raw materials. Price fluctuations and supply chain disruptions could affect margins and production capacity. However, this risk is not specifically detailed in the provided 10-K Item 1A.

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.score_rationale: IDEX operates in highly competitive markets. This competition may lead to pricing pressures, reduced profit margins, and loss of market share. The ability to maintain competitive position is critical. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Cybersecurity Threats and Data Protection
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity threats that could result in financial losses, reputational damage, legal liabilities, and operational disruptions. Although not specifically detailed in the provided excerpt, this remains a critical risk for digital operations. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Environmental and Regulatory Compliance
risks.score_rationale: IDEX is subject to environmental regulations that may result in additional costs and require changes to production processes and operations. Regulatory compliance is an ongoing requirement. (Item 1A)

ai_positioning.summary: IDEX does not explicitly mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing. The information provided focuses on financial statements, acquisitions, and business operations without reference to AI.
